Belt hero rocks — seeded irregular meshes riding each belt so the annulus reads as real varied debris (ice, metal, carbon, stone, dust; fragments through large bodies) instead of uniform glowing points. Sizes are fractions of the annulus width; every rock owns a Keplerian pivot (speed ∝ 1/√r) plus a tumble rate, both riding the shared satPivots update.
